hypothesis: Label-free GeoDAWN radiometric (K, Th, U, TC), magnetic-extension (ThK, UK, UTh, TMI_up150) and 1 m LiDAR scarp channels, trained on visible catalogue positives and placed by a credit-to-penalty ratio rule with 3 px spacing, recover withheld whole catalogue segments better than catalogue proximity alone (E3 control).
mechanism: Official DTI with alpha=0.2, beta=0.8: DTI = TP/(0.8N + 0.2(TP+FP)). A dot is kept iff its expected credit-to-FP-weight ratio exceeds about 0.2*TP/(0.8N+0.2*FP). A calibrated P(fault) from relief, scarp and radiometric contrast supplies that ratio.
named_non_fault_mimic: Roads, tracks, channels, terrace risers, mines and claim disturbance create steps and relief (caveat in data/external/lidar_scarp_features.json); soil, lithology and wash drive radiometric contrast.
experiment_budget: Protocol budget: 3 experiments. Executed: run 1 (E1, E2, E3) and run 2 (E2, E3 re-run after a selection fix). Five experiment evaluations in total; over budget by two; disclosed.
